[opaque block] Google Vault - Sub-IPC on Tech/Atrocity Prevention/Key Events
In brief, we are looking to engage with Tech companies to prevent and mitigate mass atrocities where 1) there are
upcoming Key Events that could create a risk of violence or mass atrocities, and 2) where tech platform engagement
could have a mitigating impact on those risks.
We (USAID and State) have been tasked by the WWhite House to separately prepare a list of up to five counties
where we believe the USG can engage with tech companies to mitigate risks of mass atrocities. We have been
tasked to send this list to the White House by COB on Tuesday 12/13. Both State and USAID pushed back that
this is unreasonable, but the deadline was set for us. After both State and USAID send their respective lists there will
be another Sub-IPC to crosswalk the two lists to create a final list of countries for inclusion.

provide their input, and ideally concurrence, prior to the Tuesday deadline.
The eight countries (in no particular order) are:
1. Burma
2. Bangladesh
3. Pakistan
4. Zimbabwe
5. Democratic Republic of Congo
6. Ethiopia
7. Mali
8. El Salvador
